pieces.Text: Your thick fur protects you from certain environmental hazards and makes you resistant to some types of poisons.benefit than usual from healing effects.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against cold and heat dangers. In addition, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves made to avoid contracting contact diseases and poisons. Special:At the GM's discretion, other furred races might meet the prerequisites for this feat.
